author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes: 1.9.10 - the four floating panels (Insights, External systems, Pivot tables, Device icons) could previously be opened on top of one another, left looking like several messy overlapping tabs. Opening any one now closes the others, and all four now sit below the legend instead of overlapping its top-left corner. The legend itself, while collapsed, now stays visible even while a panel is open - it only hides when expanded, since only the full legend is tall enough to run behind a panel's content the way the collapsed one-line version cannot.
